title: Lānaʻi community plan update timing
summary: Long-range planning staff told the Lānaʻi Planning Commission that an update of the Lānaʻi community plan is a while away and that 22 of its 152 actions are completed. At a later meeting, staff agreed to find out where the Lānaʻi plan stands in the county's review order.

timeline.text: Staff agreed to find out where the Lānaʻi community plan stands in the county's review order.
Staff said 22 of the 152 actions in the Lānaʻi community plan are completed, and 30 have not begun.
Leong-range planning staff said an update of the Lānaʻi community plan is a while away.
